data_sources.name: APCTT Official Checklist and Public USGS SDG Reports
data_sources.description: Public-domain USGS Scientific Investigations Reports and official APCTT checklist used only for diagnostic evaluation and schema verification.

notes: ARGUS uses a deterministic, domain-independent evidence extraction, BM25/TF-IDF retrieval, modality/negation analysis, and criterion-grounded TRL adjudication pipeline. No model weights were trained or fine-tuned.
